task.instruction: Find a recipe for a vegetarian lasagna that has at least a four-star rating and uses zucchini.

final_answer:
I found a match on Allrecipes: **Debbie's Vegetable Lasagna** — rated **4.7 out of 5** from 20 ratings (14 reviews), and it calls for **2 cups coarsely chopped zucchini**. It's fully vegetarian (no meat — the sauce is a white Parmesan/ricotta cream sauce).

https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/236878/debbies-vegetable-lasagna/

**At a glance:** Prep 25 mins · Cook 45 mins · Total 1 hr 10 mins · Serves 8 · 291 calories per serving. Submitted by Debbie, published March 9, 2020. Description: "Delicious vegetable lasagna with a white creamy sauce. A family favorite!"

**Ingredients (1x, yields 8 servings):** 9 lasagna noodles · ¼ cup margarine · ¼ cup all-purpose flour · ½ tsp salt · ¼ tsp ground black pepper · 1 cup milk · ½ cup vegetable broth (or as needed) · 2 Tbsp white wine · ½ cup grated Parmesan cheese · 1 cup light ricotta cheese · 1 egg · 1 egg white · 1 Tbsp olive oil · 2 cups coarsely shredded carrots · **2 cups coarsely chopped zucchini** · 1 (10 oz) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained · 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese.

**Directions:** (1) Boil lightly salted water and cook the lasagna noodles until tender, about 8 minutes; drain. (2) Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). (3) Melt margarine in a skillet over low heat; cook and stir in flour, salt and pepper until smooth and bubbling, 2–3 minutes. Add milk and broth, stirring constantly, and bring to a boil. Stir in wine and remove from heat, then stir in Parmesan until smooth. (4) Whisk ricotta, egg and egg white together in a bowl. (5) Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sauté carrots, zucchini and spinach until just tender, 5–10 minutes; stir the vegetable mixture into the ricotta mixture. (6) In a 9x13-inch baking dish, layer 1/3 of the noodles, 1/3 of the ricotta-vegetable mixture and 1/3 of the Parmesan sauce; repeat twice more, ending with a layer of mozzarella. (7) Bake until the cheese is lightly browned and bubbling, about 30 minutes.

**Cook's note:** It can be made ahead and refrigerated, and it freezes well. A reviewer's tip worth stealing: add garlic to the veggies and extra mozzarella between the layers.

judge.rationale: Final page shows Debbie's Vegetable Lasagna under Vegetarian Lasagna Recipes, rated 4.7, with ingredient “2 cups coarsely chopped zucchini.”
